brand.$description: CLASSIFICATION: VERIFIED (primary/accent) / DERIVED (hover/active, tonal formula) — Stage 7, artifacts/brand/BRAND-DECISION.md and artifacts/brand/UKBT-BRAND-FOUNDATION.md, EV-20260826-029. Primary/accent sampled directly from the club's own crest logo (artifacts/brand/raw/brand/crest.png), not invented, not copied from any reference template.

neutral.$description: A generic 0-900 greyscale ramp — the same convention used by nearly every design system, carrying no brand information.

surface.$description: CSS system-color keywords, not literal values — these automatically track the user's OS/browser theme (including forced-colors/high-contrast mode) rather than asserting a UKBT-specific light/dark palette that does not exist yet.

alt.$description: CLASSIFICATION: PROPOSED — 'Cream', real colour sampled from the crest (EV-20260826-029) but only a minor artwork presence there; used here as a light section background alternative to Canvas, not asserted as a decided brand surface.

inverse.$description: Dark section background (e.g. hero, footer) — same literal value as color.brand.primary (kept duplicated, not referenced, per this token set's existing no-alias convention).

overlay.$description: Overlay/ scrim colors. Named so components reference a token rather than bare rgba() literals (Stage 8 red team F8, closed for all 4 instances).

scrim.$description: Modal/drawer overlay scrim — true-black at 53% opacity. Deliberately not neutral-900 (#17181c): that color is not true black, and swapping it in would be a real color shift, not a same-color token reference.

feedback.$description: Generic, widely-recognized semantic hues (danger/success/warning) — a UI-communication convention, not a UKBT brand claim.
